description: This Java source file defines the class SagePayPaymentServices, which provides methods for integrating with the SagePay payment gateway within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class includes functions for authorization, capture, refund, void, and release operations, as well as building billing information from order context.

classes.name: SagePayPaymentServices
classes.description: Service class providing payment operations such as authorization, capture, refund, void, and release for SagePay.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Builds a map of billing information extracted from the payment and order context, including card details and address.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization by initiating the payment process through SagePay.

methods.name: processCardAuthorisationPayment
methods.description: Processes the card authorization by calling the SagePay payment authentication service and interpreting the response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Handles capturing previously authorized payments via SagePay.

methods.name: processCardCapturePayment
methods.description: Executes the capture transaction with SagePay using the stored authorization.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Manages refund requests, deciding between refund or void based on timing, and calling appropriate SagePay services.

methods.name: processCardRefundPayment
methods.description: Performs the refund transaction with SagePay.

methods.name: processCardVoidPayment
methods.description: Performs a void transaction with SagePay.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases or voids an authorization if possible.

methods.name: processCardReleasePayment
methods.description: Executes the release of an authorized payment.
